verbetes.glosa_atual: um grão de semente arredondado, coentro, (em Talm. a. Midr.) linhaça.
definicoes_originais: a rounded-off seed grain, coriander, (in Talm. a. Midr.) linseed.
notas_originais: Yoma 75 a (ref. to Ex. XVI, 7) עגול כגִידָּא וכ' the manna resembled a grain by its rounded shape, and a pearl by its white color; even so it has been taught גד שדומה לזרע וכ' the word gad (grain) is used, because the manna resembled linseed; Yalk. Ex. 261; Num. 734. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa, 5 (ref. to Ex. l. c.) איני יודע של מי דומה I do not know to which the comparison refers (to shape or to color); … דומה לזרע וכ' it resembles (in form) linseed: but you might think &c., ת"ל לבן therefore ‘white’ is added.

verbetes.glosa_atual: decreto, destino, esp. Gad (Fortuna), um deus adorado pelos babilônios e pelos exilados judeus.; גַּד יָוָן pr. n. Gad Yavan (Fortuna Grega) perto de Jerusalém.
definicoes_originais: decree, fate, esp. Gad ( Fortune), a god worshipped by the Babylonians and the Jewish exiles.
גַּד יָוָן pr. n. Gad Yavan ( Greek Fortune) near Jerusalem.
notas_originais: Snh. 63 b ג' נמי מיכתב כתיב Gad is also one of the names of idols mentioned in the Bible. Sabb. 67 b ג' אינו אלא לשון ע"א Gad is nothing else than a designation of an idol, v. next w.

Zab. I, 5 כְּמִן ג' י' לשילוה as long as it takes from G. Y. to Siloah; Tosef. ib. I, 10 כְּמִגַּדְיָוָן לשילה; Snh. 63 b כְּמִיגַּדְיָוָן לשילה (corr. acc.)—[ Gad Yavan is prob. the name of a pool connected with the Siloah, perh. Fount of the Virgin, v. Sm. Bible Dict. s. v. Siloam.] [Toh. VI, 6; Erub. 22 b בית גד גד, v. גִּלְגּוּל.]

Targ. O. Gen. XXX, 11 גָּד; Y. II גַּדָּא (not גֵּרָא). Targ. Esth. VIII, 15 גַּדָּא (not גָּדָא).—Gen. R. s. 71 ג' דביתא the good genius of the house. Sabb. 67 b גד גַּרִּי וסינוק לא (Ms. M. צינוק), a charm formula supposed to mean, Be lucky, my luck, and tire not (prob. Grow, my luck &c., v. נְגַד). R. s. 65 ג' דע"ז דאת קאים [ביה] by the idolatrous godhead by whom thou standest, i.e. to whom thou referrest in saying, ‘Let my father rise’ (Gen. XXVII, 31). Y. Sabb. XVI, end, 15 d; Y. Yoma VIII, 45 b; Y. Ned. IV, 38 d בגַדָּךְ מדלי (not בגרך) doest thou rely upon thy good luck? Koh. R. to VII, 26 מה ביש ג' וכ' how bad is this woman’s (my) luck!; a. fr.— Pl. גַּדַּיָּיא, גַּדַּיָּא. Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43 a bot. ג' קורין אותה גליא a place called Gaddaya is cacophemistically named Gallaya (dung-hills); Tosef. ib. VI (VII), 4 גדגיא ed. Zuck. (ed. גריא, corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: cortar, cortar.; cortar, nivelar.; ser cortado.; fazer incisões no próprio corpo.
definicoes_originais: to make incisions in one’s own body.
notas_originais: Par. II, 2; Bekh. 44 a יָגוֹד let him lop off (the black tops of the horns or hoofs).—[V. גָּדַר.]—Trnsf. (cmp. קצץ) to fix the price. B. Bath. 13 a גּוֹד או אָגוֹד either fix you a price for my share, or I shall do so (and buy your share); דינא דגוד או אגוד the right of settling by god o agod. Ib. אגוד איכא גוד ליכא the offer to buy is applicable in this case (the half-freed slave can offer to buy his other half), but the offer to sell cannot be made (since there is no price for a free man).— Part. pass. גָּדוּד stripped (of branches); trnsf. empty-handed. Gen. R. s. 68, beg. ג' שלחו (Yalk. ib. 117 גדודי) Isaac sent Jacob away without anything valuable.

Yeb. l. c. א"כ לימא קרא לא תְּגוֹדְדוּ if it were so (that Deut. XIV, 1 meant only to forbid incisions in the body) it ought to read lo t’god’du, ye shall make no incisions.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ótimo, distinto; (substantivo) um grande homem, líder.; adulto, maior de idade, mais velho.
definicoes_originais: great, distinguished ; (noun) a great man, leader.
notas_originais: Sabb. 94 b, a. fr. ג' כבוד הבריות וכ' human dignity is something great, for it overrules a prohibitive law &c. Ned. 49 b ג' מלאכה וכ' labor is something great, for it honors him who pursues it.—Sot. I, 9 ג' ממנו his superior. Gen. R. s. 100 גְּדוֹל העולמים the Great One of the worlds, the Lord.—Snh. 21 b גְּ' העולם a world-renowned man (Solomon). M. Kat. 22 a גְּ' הדור a prominent man of his days. Y. ib. III, 82 c top גְּ' המשפחה the chief of the family; a. v. fr.

Yeb. II, 8 בג' on the eldest brother. Ib. XIII, 11 ג' וקטנה if one of the brother’s widows is of age, and the other a minor; a. fr.—כהן גדול (abbr. כ"ג) Highpriest. Ib. IX, 1; a. fr.— Pl. גְּדוֹלִים, גְּדוֹלִין; גְּדוֹלוֹת. Koh. R. to VII, 8 גְּדוֹלֵי הדור scholars, v. supra; ג' ירושלים prominent citizens of Jerusalem.—Ab. Zar. 18 a ג' רומי Roman dignitaries; a. fr.—Ber. 23 b, a. e. גדולים (sub. נקבים) the larger functions of the body, movement of the bowels; v. דַּק.
, v. גִּידּוּל

verbetes.glosa_atual: grandeza, distinção, dignidade, riqueza, posição elevada, cargo.

notas_originais: Gitt. 59 a תורה וג' במקום א' learning and high office combined in one person. Ber. 61 a בג' מתחילין מן הגדול וכ' for distinction the superior is first mentioned, for degradation the inferior. Erub. 13 b מחזר על הג' hunting for office. Ib. 54 a עולה לג' will rise to distinction. Y. Ter. V, 43 c top למשחה לג' וכ' ‘ for ointment’ (Num. XVIII, 1

means for installation in office, for unguent, and for lighting. Meg. 31 a גְּדוּלָּתוֹ של הקב"ה Ms. M. (ed. גבורתו) a description of the greatness of the Lord. Ex. R. s. 3 end הלב ששמח בגדוּלַּת אחיו וכ' the heart (of Aaron) which rejoiced over a brother’s distinction shall wear the Urim &c.; a. fr.

II, 58 a top הרי מכוור וג' (as stations for signalizing the New Moon) the mountains of Mikhvar and G’dor (Bab. ib. 23 b חרים וכייר וגֶדֶר, corr. acc., v. גֶּדֶר); Y. Shebi. IX, 38 d bot.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. גדד I) cortar, dividir, atribuir.; cortar, excomungar.
definicoes_originais: (v. גדד I) to cut, divide, assign.
notas_originais: Nidd. 36 b ואי לא צאית גַּרְיֵיה הוא סבר גַּדְּיֵיה א"ל and if he does not obey, drag him over (v. גרי, i.e. force him with arguments), but he (R. Assé) understood that he told him gadd’yeh (excommunicate him). Ib. לא ציית גדייה he (Shila bar Abina) did not obey, and he (R. Assé) excommunicated him (Rashi). [Tosaf. read for גרייה: גַּדְיֵיה, fr. גדי, a sec. form of נגד, draw him over.—Ar. s. v. צנע 2 reads גַּדְּדֵיה lash him (ref. to Deut. XIV,
, without referring to any misapprehension, while s. v. גר 10 הוא סבר גרייה א"ל is quoted—obviously a later insertion of a copyist.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.); garoto, em gen. animal jovem.; o Capricórnio, um signo do Zodíaco.
definicoes_originais: the Capricorn, a sign in the Zodiac.
notas_originais: Ḥull. 113 ab (ref. to Gen. XXXVIII, 17) כאן ג' עזים וכ' here it reads g’di izzim from which we learn that wherever g’di without any qualification is used, it includes cow and sheep. Men. XIII, 7; a. fr.— Pl. גְּדָיִם, גְּדָיִים. Snh. 11 a; Tosef. ib. II, 4 מפני הג' וכ' on account of the kids or lambs (being too young for offerings on Passover).—Y. ib. X, 28 b bot.; Gen. R. s. 42, a. e. אם אין ג' אין תישים when there will be no kids (young students), there will be no wethers (leaders, scholars). Y. ib. I, 19 a top ג' שהנחת וכ' the kids (young scholars) thou hast left behind (in Palestine) have grown to be wethers; a. e.—Trnsf. the tender grain in its husks. Pesik. Asser p. 99 b; Tanḥ. R’eh 17; Yalk. Deut. 892 (homiletic interpret. of Deut. XV, 21) אל תגרמו לי לבשל ג' וכ' do not cause me to ripen the grains in their mothers’ womb (husks, so as to be blown out by the East wind).
Pesik. R. s. 20. Yalk. Ex. 418; Kings 185. [Yalk. Num. 785 הרי נכנס הזאב לגדי, v. גדיגוד.]

Targ. O. Gen. XXXVIII, 17; 20 (Y. גידי, גירי (?)); 23 O. a. Y. גַּדְיָא.—Pes. 3 b גדי מסנקן, v. סְנַק. Sabb. 18 b דג' (בשרא) meat of a kid. Ib. 20 a. XVII, 18) גדיין מניעין וכ' kids taken away from their mothers.—גַּדְיָיתָא. Targ. Y. Num. XV, 27 (h. text עֵז).

Y. Sot. IX, 24 b אצל בית ג' (Snh. 11 a בעליית בית גּוּרְיָא). Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 9; Pesik. Zakhor p. 25 ab יודן בן ג'; Lam. R. to III, 64 גדייא; Yalk. Ps. 827 (Yalk. Sam. 123 Ms. O. גּוּרְיָא, v. Bub. Pesik. l. c. note 76).

definicoes_originais: (גדל) growing, esp. one entering on puberty.
notas_originais: Tosef. Mikv. VI, 10, v. כָּשׁוּת.— Pl. גְּדֵילִים, v. גָּדַל I.

verbetes.glosa_atual: por favor. גְּדִילִים, גְּדִילִין fios torcidos, franjas, v. torção, toalha de mesa.
definicoes_originais: pl. גְּדִילִים, גְּדִילִין twisted threads, fringes, v. צִיצִית.
notas_originais: Men. 39 b; Yeb. 5 b גדיל שנים ג' ארבעה gadil (a twist) means at least two threads, g’dilim means four threads (which doubled make eight). Sifré Num. 115; a. e.
B. Bath. 57 b שני שלישי ג' … גלוי וכ' Ar. a. Ms. O. (ed. גלאי) two thirds of the width of the table covered and one third uncovered for putting on dishes and vegetables.
Y. Pes. IV, end, 31 c (Esth. R. to I, 4 גדיש).
Men. 39 b top וג' מיגדיל and the fringe is twisted (without leaving loose threads). Pl. fem. גְּדִילָן, v. גְּדִילְתָּא.

דרך ג' the way a thing grows, in natural position. Nidd. 67 a דרך גְּדִילָתָהּ in her natural position (not pressing limbs together). Succ. 45 b דרך גְּדִילָתָן as the plants grow (not upside down); a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: f. = גָּדִיל 1). Sifré Num. 115 שתהא ג' יוצא וכ' a franja torcida deve começar na borda, e as franjas soltas devem começar na torção; Iaque. eu. 750.
notas_originais: f. = גָּדִיל 1). Sifré Num. 115 שתהא ג' יוצא וכ' the twisted fringe must start from the border, and the loose fringes out of the twist; Yalk. ib. 750.
Targ. O. Ex. XXVIII, 14; a. e. (h. text עבת).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) corda, corrente, faixa de cabelo, franja.
definicoes_originais: (preced.) rope, chain, plat of hair, fringe.
notas_originais: Targ. Is. V, 18.— Pl. גְּדִילָן, גְּדִילָתָא. Targ. Jud. XV, 13 sq. Targ. Y. II Deut. XXII, 12. Targ. O. Ex. XXVIII, 4; 24; a. e.
, v. גְּדִי ch.—[Targ. Y. Num. XXII, 7 Ar., read אִגְּרִין.]
, v. גִּידּוּפָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: cerca, guarda, precaução contra infringir a lei.
definicoes_originais: fence, guard, precaution against trespassing the law.
notas_originais: Y. Dem. I, 21 d מפני גְדֵירָהּ, מפני גְדֵירוֹ in order to guard it against transgressing. Gen. R. s. 79 (גְּדֵרָן) פרצת גְּדֵירָן של וכ' thou hast broken down the guard (enactment) which the scholars have erected; a. fr.
Targ. O. Num. XXII, 24; a. e.—ג' מיצעא דאודנא the central fence of the ear, anti-helix. Targ. Y. Lev. VIII, 23, a. e. (h. text תְּנוּךְ).—B. Kam. 23 b לגדור מר ג' וכ' erect you a fence in your field.

Cant. R. to IV, 12 גְּדֵירַת ערוה moral restraint, v. גֶּדֶר.— Pl. גְּדֵירוֹת. Pesik. R. s. 26 saw the Temple (which the angels had set on fire) עשוי לו ג' ג' של אבנים (Yalk. Jer. 300 גזרות של אבנים) surrounded with stone fences (fortified).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גדר) datas de corte, data de colheita.
notas_originais: — Pl. גְּדִירוֹת. B. Bath. 36 b (Ar. a. ed. Pes. גדיד'), v. גָּדַר.
Esth. R. to I, 4; v. גְּדִיל.

verbetes.glosa_atual: um monte, esp. de feixes, choque ou pilha de grãos; [em b. h. também monte].
definicoes_originais: a heap, esp. of sheaves, shock or stack of grain; [in b. h. also mound].
notas_originais: B. Mets. V, 7 פוסק עמו על הג' he may conclude a bargain with him (the early harvester) for the grain in the stack (though no price has been published as yet). Peah VI, 2. Yad. IV, 7.— Pl. גְּדִישִׁים, גְּדִישִׁין. Gen. R. s. 51 end. B. Kam. 60 b. Pesik. Shubah p. 164 a ג' ג' של עבירות heaps of sins; a. e. [V. גָּדוּשׁ.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: , pilha; monte, Targ. Y. Ex. XXII, 5.
definicoes_originais: , pile; mound, Targ. Y. Ex. XXII, 5.
notas_originais: Targ. Job V, 26.—Y. Sabb. XVI, 15 d, end, spread his cloak על ג' over a burning stalk.— Pl. גְּדִישִׁין. Targ. O. Ex. XXII, 5. Targ. Job XXI, 32.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גְּדַשׁ II) equipe, líder de um cego.
definicoes_originais: (גְּדַשׁ II) staff, leader of a blind man.
notas_originais: Lev. R. s. 22; Yalk. Koh. 972 והוה ההיא … ג' ליה וכ' and the seeing man was a leader to the blind man.
Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 35.
, v. גַּדְיָא I

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. גדל II) ser alto, crescer, ser grande, alto.; criar (de gado e de plantas); criar, treinar.; elevar à dignidade, tornar famoso; elogiar.; crescer, atingir a maioridade.
definicoes_originais: v. גדל II) to be high, to grow, be large, tall.
to raise (of live stock and of plants); to rear, train.
to raise to dignity, make famous; to praise.
to grow up, to become of age.
ע"י פָּרוֹת נ' by means of cows (Pharaoh’s dream) was he raised to power; a. fr.— to be magnified.
to glorify one’s self, to boast, parade.
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 1 שהיה גָדֵל שלא וכ' he was extraordinarily tall for his age. Ib. וכי אין הכל גְּדֵילִים do not all children grow?—Y. Maasr. I, 49 a, v. טְפוּס; a. fr. Fem. גְּדֵילָה, pl. גְּדֵילוֹת. Succ. 34 a; a. fr.

Kil. VIII, 1 מותרים לגַדֵּל you are permitted to raise. Snh. 19 b מיכל גִּידְּלָה Michal reared (Mirab’s children). Ib.; Meg. 13 a המְגַדֵּל יתום וכ' he who educates an orphan in his house. Gen. R. s. 98 היו … מְגַדְּלִים שער they let their hair grow (in mourning). Erub. 100 b מְגַדָּלֶת שער she lets her hair grow (does not cut it); a. fr.

Hor. 9 a (ref. to Lev. XXI, 10) whence do we know אם אין לו שחייבין לגַדְּלוֹ when he (the Highpriest) is poor, that they (the brethren) are bound to raise him (make him independent)? Ib. גַּדְּלֵהוּ משל אחיו raise him by a collection from his brethren (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.). Esth. R. to III, 1 למה גִדְּלוֹ for what purpose did (the Lord) raise him? Yalk. Esth. 1053 עד היכן גִּידְּלוֹ וכ' how high did he raise him? Fifty cubits (to the gallows); a. fr.—Y. Meg. III, end, 74 c (ref. to הגדול, Neh. VIII, 6) במה גִידְּלֹו wherewith did he magnify the Lord (describe His greatness)?; Yoma 69 b ג' בשם וכ' he praised the Lord by pronouncing the tetragrammaton; Y. Ber. VII, 11 c גודלו (corr. acc.)—Part. pass. מְגוּדָּל well grown. Ber. 11 a; a. fr.—Kidd. 49 a, b, v. גַּדֶּלֶת.
Yeb. X, 9 וּמִשֶּׁהִ' and after he is of age. Ib. XIII, 1 עד שתַּגְדִּיל until she becomes of age; a. fr.
נִתְגַּדֵּל
Esth. R. to III, 1 יִתְגַּדֵּל ואח"כ יתלה let him first become great and then be hanged. Gen. R. s. 99, end (play on פֹּרָת, Gen. XLIX, 2
Y. Ber. IX, 14 a top; Y. Taan. I, 64 b top יִתְגַּדֵּל וכ' may Thy Name be glorified, sanctified &c.; a. e.
Ned. 62 a; Ab. IV, 5 אל תעשם עטרה להִתְגַּדֵּל בהם make them (the words of the Law) not a crown to parade therewith.

Tanḥ. V’zoth 1; Pesik. ib. p. 199 a הרי … מִתְגַּדֵּל עמו the poison-bearing tree will be nursed along with it (the health-giving tree). Tanḥ. B’resh. 7 נִתְגַּדַּלְתָּ וחטאת thou didst grow older and didst sin, opp. תינוק היית; a. fr.
Kidd. 71 b ג' ולא נסיב was grown up and not yet married.
Ḥag. 4 b מרים מְגַדְּלָא דרדקי Miryam, the childrens’ nurse.
Targ. Ps. CIV, 1.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido .; cmp. גדש) [ amontoar, arredondar;] trançar, pentear o cabelo.
definicoes_originais: (v. preced.; cmp. גדש) [ to heap up, round ;] to plait, dress the hair.
notas_originais: Kel. XVI, 7 גּוֹדְלֵי מצנפות capweavers (on a model head, v. אִמּוּם). Ib. XV, 3 וגוֹדְלוֹת and dress their hair. Sabb. X, 6 הגּוֹדֶלֶת she who plaits her hair (on the Sabbath). Ib. 94 b bot. גודלת משום אורגת plaiting the hair (is forbidden on the Sabbath) as an act of weaving; ib. 95 a (another opin.) ג' … משום בונה as an act of building. Y. ib. VII, 10 d הגודל כלי צורה he who forms raised figures on a vessel. M. Kat. 11 a ג' תנור to build a stove.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Git. 69 a ניגדול תרתי וכ' deixe-o amarrar dois fios. M. Kat. 11 a למִיגְדַּל אהורי para tecer redes; למי' תנורא construir um fogão, v.
notas_originais: Gitt. 69 a ניגדול תרתי וכ' let him twine two threads. M. Kat. 11 a למִיגְדַּל אהורי to weave nets; למי' תנורא to build a stove, v. preced.

same. Ḥag. 4 b מרים מְגַדְּלָא נשייא Ms. M. (ed. מג' שיער נ') Miriam the women’s hair-dresser (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Snh. 67 a; Sabb. 104 b (missing in later editions). Succ. 37 a הנהו מְגַדְּלֵי הושענא those twining the willow twigs (v. הוֹשַׁעְנָא).
, v. גִּידּוֹל
Yalk. Ps. 777, v. גִּידּוּל.
Y. Keth. XII, 35 a bot. (Y. Kil. IX, 32 b bot. גרדיי).

Kel. XV, 3 the sieve-like receptacle של גד' (Mish. ed. גּוֹדְלוֹת pl.) of the hair-dresser. Kidd. II, 3 ע"מ שיש לי בת או שפחה גד' וכ' (Y. a. Talm. ed. 49 b מגודלת, Ar. מגדלת) under the condition that I shall have a (free) girl or a hand-maid as a hair-dresser, and she has none, or ‘that I shall have none’, and she has. Ib. 49 a מי סברת מאי מגודלת גדולה ממש מאי מגודלת גדלת וכ' do you think m’guddeleth of the Mishnah means really a well-trained (girl or hand-maid)? It means a hair-dresser, when she may see, I want none to take up my words and carry them to my neighbors. Y. ib. II, 62 c bot. כיני מתניתן בת לגוֹדַלְתֵּיךְ ושפחה לשמשותיך the Mishnah means this: a girl for thy hair-dresser (or thy governess), and a hand-maid for thy attendant. Lev. R. s. 19 נפיים לַגַּ' וְהַגַּ' וכ' let us win the favor of the (queen’s) hair-dresser (or governess), and the hair-dresser will win the queen and the queen the king; Gen. R. s. 100.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. גדד I) cortar, toco.; ser cortado, podado.
definicoes_originais: (v. גדד I) to lop off, stump.
notas_originais: —Part. pass. גָּדוּם, f. גְּדוּמָה. Zeb. 62 b אמה ג' (Y. Yoma IV, 41 c bot. גְּמוּדָה) a reduced cubit, v. אַמָּה. [Gen. R. s. 12 אמה ג', read גְּרוּמָה, v. גָּרַם.] Tosef. Bekh. V, 4 אצבעותיו גְּדוּמוֹת ed. Zuck. (Var. גרומות) with stump-like fingers.
Taan. 21 a ידי … יִתְגַּדְּמוּ may my hands … be stumped (through sickness).
Parel גּרְדֵּם.
, v. גִּידֵּם

Targ. O. Ex. XXV, 25, a. e. (ed. Berl. גְּדֳ', Y. גפוף, h. text מסגרת). Targ. Ezek. XLIII, 13; 17 (h. text גבול).—Succ. 20 b דאית ליה ג' (Ms. M. גדפנא, Ar. גדפא) when the matting has a rim (so as to be used as a receptacle for fruits). Ab. Zar. 76 ab אהדר ליה ג' דלישא made a rim of dough around the kettle.— Pl. גְּדַנְפִין, גְּדָנְפַיָא. Targ. I Kings VII, 28 sq. Targ. II Kings XVI, 17. V. גַּדְפָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. גדד I) cortar, picar, decepar.; ser cortado, diminuído.
definicoes_originais: v. גדד I) to cut, chop, lop off.
notas_originais: —Y. Sabb. IV, end, 7 a חריות שגְּדָעָן וכ' twigs which one cut off (trimming the date tree) with the intention of using them for &c. (Bab. ib. 50 a גדר).—Part. pass. גָּדוּעַ, f. גְּדוּעָה; pl. גְּדוּעִים, גְּדוּעוֹת. Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXV, end קרני ישראל ג' the horns (power) of Israel are lopped off (checked).
. Ib.; Midr. Sam. ch. V, end קרנות שג' צדיקו וכ' the horns which the Righteous One of the world (the Lord) has lopped.
Cant. R. to III, 7 נ' גובה וכ' (Var. נגרע, v. גרע) Adam’s high stature was reduced. [V. גָּוַע.]
*Targ. II Sam. X, 4 (ed. Lag. גרע).
Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 12; Num. XXXIII, 4.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cmp. precedido.) cortar, raspar.; escavar, raspar ou cinzelar de modo a formar um invólucro ou borda (cmp. גדפא, גדנפא).; raspar, esvaziar até a última gota.
definicoes_originais: to hollow out, scrape or chisel so as to form an enclosure or rim (cmp. גדפא, גדנפא).
to scrape, to empty to the dregs.
notas_originais: Part. pass. גָּדוּף, pl. גְּדוּפִין. Pes. 42 a מים הג' Ar., v. גָּרַף.—מיתה גְדוּפָה, v. infra.

Kerith. 7 b (explain. מגדף, Num. XV, 30, as a metaphor) as one says to his neighbor גִּדַּפְתָּ את הקערה וחיסרת Ar. (ed. גֵירַ'; Sifré Num. 112 גֵרַרְתָּה מן וכ') thou hast scraped out the dish and lessened the thickness of the vessel (i.e. besides worshipping the forces of Nature to impair, so to speak, the supremacy of the Creator); he who thus explains, is of the opinion that מגדף means blaspheming the Divine Name; ג' הקערה ולא וכ' thou hast scraped the dish clean but not impaired it (i.e. to worship natural forces without denying the Divine supremacy); he who thus explains, is of the opinion that מגדף is a worshipper of idols; [Y. Snh. VII, 25 b top גיר' את כל וכ' thou hast emptied the whole dish and left nothing in it, i.e. thou hast erased the entire Law; Sifré l. c. גררתה וכ'].—Trnsf. (cmp. ארר, קלל, נקב) to blaspheme (God); to revile, reproach. Kerith. I, 2 אף המְגַדֵּף the blasphemer is also excluded from the rule (and has not to offer a sacrifice in the case of sinning through ignorance); expl. ib. 7 b, v. supra. Snh. VII, 5; a. fr.—Num. R. s. 10 לפי שהיה מחרפם ומְגַדְּפָם בנחיצה לכן מת מיתה גְדוּפָה וכ' because be (Sisera) disgraced and reviled them (the Israelites) with oppressive measures, therefore he died an ignominious death, for (the Lord) delivered him into the hands of a woman; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Pa. גַּדֵּיף; mesmo, blasfemar.; (com ב) para zombar.
notas_originais: Targ. I Kings XXI, 13; a. e.—Y. M. Kat. III, 83 b; Y. Snh. VII, 25 b top.
Snh. 40 b; Ab. Zar. 35 a … מְגַדֵּף בה ר' R. … sneered at the opinion.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. גָּדַף) Pi.; escavado, de onde a borda, borda.; (cmp. כָּנָף) asa.
notas_originais: Succ. 20 b; Ab. Zar. 76 ab Ar., v. גְּדָנְפָא.

Targ. Job XXXIX, 13. Targ. O. Deut. IV, 17 (ed. Berl. גַּפָּא, v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 50); a. e.—B. Bath. 73 b דלי ג' (Rashbam דליא לי גדנפא, Ms. O. גפא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40) lifted (towards me) a wing.—Trnsf. bird; feather, plumage. Keth. 105 b פרח ג' וכ' a bird flew on his head. Gitt. 86 a בג' דאווזא with a goose feather; Ab. Zar. 28 a. Ḥull. 46 b we put on it ג' או רוקא a feather or some spittle.— Pl. גַּדְפִין, גַּדְפֵי (גִּי'). Targ. Job XXXVIII, 13 borders of the earth. Targ. Ex. XXXVII, 9. Targ. Y. Gen. I, 21; a. e.—B. Bath. l. c. דשמטי גַדְפַיְיהוּ וכ' whose feathers fell out on account of their fatness. Ḥull. 31 a we see גידפי דמיפרמי that the rims of the cut throat stand apart (Rashi: that the plumage of the throat is cut through).

verbetes.glosa_atual: , YB Mets. IV, implore. 9 d לג', leia מבקרא, como Y. Gitt. IV, 48 b superior; cmp. Y. Peah III, 17 d bot.
notas_originais: , Y. B. Mets. IV, beg. 9 d לג', read מבקרא, as Y. Gitt. IV, 48 b top; cmp. Y. Peah III, 17 d bot.
, v. כַּתְּפִי

— Pl. גַּדְּפָנִין, גֹּודְ'. Y. M. Kat. III, 83 b משרבו הגד' וכ' since the (gentile) blasphemers (of the Lord) became too numerous, they (the Israelites) ceased to rend their garments (on hearing blasphemy); Y. Snh. VII, 25 b top הגי' (corr. acc.).—Y. Yoma VII, 44 c top; Cant. R. to IV, 4 על הגו' (Lev. R. s. 10 על המְגַדְּפִים) atones for the blasphemers.
